name: Rizuhble's Ice Pack Kelvin
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Frost Grenade T3, Frozen Shelter unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Improved Spirit. Ultimate (Frozen Shelter) is available from Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Frost Grenade (2 to 3).

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enchanter's Emblem, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enchanter's Emblem, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 8 to Ice Path's explode damage (0.80x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Frost Grenade: widens its radius.
items.why: imminent: Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Frost Grenade: takes 18% off its 20s base cooldown.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. +18 spirit adds about 25.2 to Frost Grenade's damage (1.40x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-20,000 (levels 12-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Frozen Shelter T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Frost Grenade, damage) grows from 198 to 261. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enchanter's Emblem completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enchanter's Emblem completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enchanter's Emblem completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Enchanter's Emblem completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for a second counter.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for a third counter.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Frost Grenade (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 238s; 20% off is 47.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Ice Path: its duration-scaled parts (duration 8s) get +22%.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,000-46,400 (levels 25-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Ice Path T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Frost Grenade, damage) grows from 261 to 401.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 15,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 42 to Frost Grenade's damage (1.40x scaling).

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Takes spirit from 15,200 to 21,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 238s of base cooldown across your kit, 165s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 21,600 to 28,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Frozen Shelter radius (10m), Arctic Beam path length (25m), Frost Grenade radius (8.5m). Takes spirit from 28,000 to 30,400 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Frozen Shelter duration (6.5s), Ice Path duration (8s), Arctic Beam duration (5s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Trophy Collector.
sections.desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Trophy Collector.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Geist, Vyper.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Ice Path (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: You keep getting stunned before you can dome.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this. Otherwise sell Trophy Collector.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Frozen Shelter gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (165s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 14,400 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Cast it on the mate who's diving in. Sell Healbane for this.

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
